title: Identification of new lead molecules against anticancer drug target TFIIH subunit P8 using biophysical and molecular docking studies.
authors: Javaid, Sumaira; Zafar, Humaira; Atia-Tul-Wahab; Gervais, Virginie; Ramos, Pascal; Muller, Isabelle; Milon, Alain; Atta-Ur-Rahman; Choudhary, M Iqbal
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物物理筛选和分子对接鉴定靶向TFIIH p8亚基的小分子，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或MD模拟，仅常规对接，与TF-DNA结合机制课题关联较弱。
abstract: The identification of molecules, which could modulate protein-protein interactions (PPIs), is of primary interest to medicinal chemists. Using biophysical methods during the current study, we have screened 76 compounds (grouped into 16 mixtures) against the p8 subunit of the general transcription factor (TFIIH), which has recently been validated as an anti-cancer drug target. 10% of the tested compounds showed interactions with p8 protein in STD-NMR experiments. These results were further validated by molecular docking studies where interactions between compounds and important amino acid residues were identified, including Lys20 in the hydrophobic core of p8, and Asp42 and 43 in the beta3 strand. Moreover, these compounds were able to destabilize the p8 protein by negatively shifting the Tm (>/=2  degrees C) in thermal shift assay. Thus, this study has identified 8 compounds which are likely negative modulators of p8 protein stability, and could be further considered as potential anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: 能够调节蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）的分子的识别，对药物化学家而言具有首要兴趣。在本研究中，利用生物物理方法，我们针对通用转录因子（TFIIH）的p8亚基筛选了76种化合物（分为16个混合物），该亚基最近已被验证为抗癌药物靶点。在STD-NMR实验中，10%的测试化合物显示出与p8蛋白的相互作用。这些结果通过分子对接研究进一步验证，其中识别了化合物与重要氨基酸残基之间的相互作用，包括p8疏水核心中的Lys20，以及β3链中的Asp42和43。此外，这些化合物能够通过热位移实验中负向移动Tm（≥2摄氏度）来使p8蛋白不稳定。因此，本研究识别了8种可能作为p8蛋白稳定性负调节剂的化合物，并可能进一步被视为潜在的抗癌药物。
